# New Stuff & Tweaks

# Creative Menu
- Consolidated all creative tabs malum added into one, with the exception of Geas and Cosmetics
- This new creative tab has some cool visual differences to the usual

# Arcane Rock
- Tainted Rock and Twisted Rock block sets have been changed
- The following block types are now gone:
  - Smooth
  - Small bricks
  - Runic bricks
  - Runic tiles
  - Runic small bricks
  - Column cap (consolidated into one block alongside the Column segment)
  - Checkered
- The following block types have been added:
  - Column (Consolidation of the two unique block types before)
  - Mosaic
  - Altar
- Arcane Rock Item Pedestals, Item Stands, Altars and Columns now have new place/break/hit/step sounds
- The Spirit Crucible, Spirit Catalyzer and Repair Pylon now have new place/break/hit/step sounds
- Stonecutting recipes are now much more organized, similar to how Create does it

# Spirited Glass
- Updated the textures and opacity of Spirited Glass
- Added Null Spirited Glass
- Spirited Glass can no longer suffocate, conduct redstone, and some other stuff too - essentially just matching glass in various misc. behaviours

# Blight
- Added Columnar Blight

# Varnished Terracotta
- Added Null Varnished Terracotta

# Ether
- Updated the model for Ether Braziers
- Added Ether Cressets
- Added Ether Candles

# Geas Changes

# Pact of the Lone Druid
- Damaging effect only kicks in when beneath half health, but grows stronger with each equipped armor piece
- This change is meant to allow you to wear *some* armor, without getting totally screwed over

# Scythes
- Scythes can now get Fire Aspect and Looting

# Bugfixes
- Fixed the Belt of the Prospector Entry being way too long, I forgot to run datagen...
